def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    main = grid[h // 2][w // 2]
    color = next(v for v in grid[0] + grid[-1] if v != main)
    top = all(v == color for v in grid[0])
    bottom = all(v == color for v in grid[-1])
    left = all(grid[r][0] == color for r in range(h))
    right = all(grid[r][-1] == color for r in range(h))
    out = [[8] * w for _ in range(h)]
    if top:
        for c in range(w - 1): out[0][c] = main
    if bottom:
        for c in range(1, w): out[-1][c] = main
    if left:
        for r in range(1, h): out[r][0] = main
    if right:
        for r in range(h - 1): out[r][-1] = main
    vr = 1 if top else h - 2
    vc = 1 if left else w - 2
    if top:
        for c in range(w - 1): out[vr][c] = color
    else:
        for c in range(1, w): out[vr][c] = color
    if left:
        for r in range(h - 1): out[r][vc] = color
    else:
        for r in range(1, h): out[r][vc] = color
    out[vr][vc] = 8
    dr = 1 if top else -1
    dc = 1 if left else -1
    r, c = vr + dr, vc + dc
    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
        out[r][c] = main
        r += dr
        c += dc
    return out
```
